# spacelab-slr

Satellite laser ranging: CRD normal points, SINEX station coordinates, Mendes-Pavlis refraction, IERS station displacement and the two-way range observation model.

Part of [spacelab](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab), astrodynamics in Rust organised around independent
verification: every published number is checked against a lineage that did not come
from the project. This crate is verified in [§4 Estimation, control, sensors, coverage & constellations](https://github.com/SpaceDataLab/spacelab/blob/main/docs/verification.md#4--estimation-control-sensors-coverage--constellations) (12 rows).

- API documentation: <https://docs.rs/spacelab-slr>
- Homepage: <https://spacedatalab.org>
